topline.text: Quiet 24-48 hours nationally - no new SEND, safeguarding or funding announcement cleared the corroboration bar, so today's edition stays short rather than padded.
DfE's call for evidence on exclusion reform (internal suspension, reintegration partnerships, schoolwork during suspension) closes today, 19 November.
topline.action: Last chance for any Sheffield-side input - the window closes today.

topline.text: Grand Theft Auto VI's UK launch lands today, with some English schools bracing for an attendance dip and at least one running a same-day incentive to keep pupils in.
topline.action: Worth flagging to attendance/pastoral leads in case today or tomorrow shows an unusual blip.

diary.text: DfE's call for evidence on school exclusion reform closes today.
Anti-Bullying Week 2026 continues - 'Break the Silence' theme - running to Friday.
DfE's autumn 2025/26 suspensions and permanent exclusions statistics for England still due this month.

items.lede: Exclusion reform call for evidence closes today.
items.body: The DfE's call for evidence on behaviour management - covering internal suspension, reintegration support partnerships and schoolwork provision during the first days of a suspension or permanent exclusion - reaches its deadline today. It feeds proposed reforms in the 'Every Child Achieving and Thriving' white paper.
items.action: Any outstanding Sheffield-side submission needs to go in today.

items.lede: GTA VI's launch day prompts an attendance watch in English schools.
items.body: Tes reports schools bracing for higher absence today as pupils stay home to play the long-awaited game's release; at least one English Catholic secondary is running a prize-draw incentive for pupils who attend and complete the full day, warning that skipping class - or turning up exhausted after gaming all night - would both count as a 'mission fail'.
items.action: A light one to flag to attendance leads - worth knowing the likely cause if today's figures look odd.

box.label: Jargon-buster - call for evidence
box.intro: Today's deadline uses a specific term worth knowing.
box.text: A 'call for evidence' gathers real-world examples and data to inform policy at an early stage - a looser ask than a full 'consultation', which tests reaction to firm draft proposals.
